package.name: threevn_navigation
package.description:
Knowing which way the robot is pointing.
Phase 10 measured that wheel odometry on a skid-steer chassis gets heading badly wrong, and that the standard correction saturates because scrub is not a fixed track-width error. This package fuses the gyroscope, which measures rotation directly, with the wheel encoders, which measure distance well.
It is NOT a Nav2 stack, and the reason is in docs/navigation.md: this robot has no range sensor, so there is nothing for a costmap to see or for a scan matcher to match. Heading first.
ARCHITECTURAL RULE: never depends on Gazebo. It consumes Odometry and Imu, which a simulated robot and a real one both publish.
